crossRefs.note: They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.
Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
Hear Yahweh’s word, you who tremble at his word: “Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name’s sake, have…
“Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.
Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s…
Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of…
For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice…
They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me…
Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is…
For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN…
When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one word, “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly…
Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are…
which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.
Wake up righteously, and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,
punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

translations.web: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
translations.bsb: But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.
translations.kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
translations.asv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
